name: The Summoning
storyline:
Last night, there was a murder inside an abandoned house in a partially vacant neighbourhood. The scene has already been cleaned, and detectives got everything they want, but the security company I work for has been hired to watch this place.

Due to the nature of the crime, they suspect the house will be a gold mine for adventure seekers and vandalism.

Stupid kids, don't they see enough death on the news and in movies? Anyway, I'm heading there for my first shift.

I'm not particularly superstitious, but that house is known for being haunted. I just hope I don't get mugged getting there. The buses don't run through that neighbourhood anymore...
